summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting routine director/PDMR share transactions. Non-executive directors, including Robert Berry and Dawn Fitzpatrick, acquired ordinary shares at £4.974 per share on July 28, 2026, as part of a policy to use part of director fees to purchase company shares. These are routine insider buys, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; this is a standard ongoing disclosure.
